   1: #!/usr/bin/env python3
   2: """Verify main experiment and few-shot use identical frozen hyperparameters."""
   3: import sys
   4: import os
   5: import json
   6: import pandas as pd
   7: import numpy as np
   8: 
   9: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  10: 
  11: RESULTS_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "results")
  12: 
  13: 
  14: def main():
  15:     print("=" * 70)
  16:     print("CONSISTENCY CHECK: Main Experiment vs Few-Shot")
  17:     print("=" * 70)
  18: 
  19:     # Load main results
  20:     main_path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "main_results_runs.csv")
  21:     if not os.path.exists(main_path):
  22:         print(f"ERROR: {main_path} not found. Run main experiment first.")
  23:         return 1
  24:     main_runs = pd.read_csv(main_path)
  25: 
  26:     # Load few-shot results
  27:     fs_path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "fewshot.csv")
  28:     if not os.path.exists(fs_path):
  29:         print(f"ERROR: {fs_path} not found. Run few-shot experiment first.")
  30:         return 1
  31:     fewshot = pd.read_csv(fs_path)
  32: 
  33:     # Load frozen hparams
  34:     frozen_path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "best_hparams_per_method_arch.json")
  35:     if not os.path.exists(frozen_path):
  36:         print(f"ERROR: {frozen_path} not found. Run validation tuning first.")
  37:         return 1
  38:     with open(frozen_path) as f:
  39:         frozen = json.load(f)
  40: 
  41:     print("\n1. HYPERPARAMETER CONSISTENCY CHECK")
  42:     print("-" * 70)
  43:     for arch in frozen:
  44:         if not isinstance(frozen[arch], dict):
  45:             continue  # skip metadata keys like "_note"
  46:         for method in frozen[arch]:
  47:             h = frozen[arch][method].get("hparams", {})
  48:             if h:
  49:                 print(f"  Frozen: {arch:5s}/{method:10s} -> {h}")
  50: 
  51:     print("\n2. MAIN vs FEW-SHOT (K=150) CONSISTENCY CHECK")
  52:     print("-" * 70)
  53:     # K=150 in few-shot (CuCD-ID only) should correspond to main matrix
  54:     # CuCD-ID uplink_n_per_class=150; filter dataset to avoid STIN mixing.
  55:     # Few-shot PLAN covers MLP[replay,full,icarl,bic] + GRU[replay,icarl] only.
  56:     mismatch_count = 0
  57:     PLAN_CHECK = [
  58:         ("MLP", ["replay", "full", "icarl", "bic"]),
  59:         ("GRU", ["replay", "icarl"]),
  60:     ]
  61:     for arch, methods in PLAN_CHECK:
  62:         for method in methods:
  63:             main_rows = main_runs[(main_runs.dataset == "CuCD-ID") & (main_runs.arch == arch) & (main_runs.method == method)]
  64:             fs_rows = fewshot[(fewshot.arch == arch) & (fewshot.method == method) & (fewshot.K == 150)]
  65: 
  66:             if len(main_rows) > 0 and len(fs_rows) > 0:
  67:                 # Compare on intersecting seeds only (main has 10, few-shot has 5)
  68:                 common_seeds = sorted(set(main_rows.seed.tolist()) & set(fs_rows.seed.tolist()))
  69:                 main_sub = main_rows[main_rows.seed.isin(common_seeds)]
  70:                 main_acc = main_sub.ACC.mean()
  71:                 fs_acc = fs_rows.ACC.mean()
  72:                 diff = abs(main_acc - fs_acc)
  73: 
  74:                 # Also check if hyperparameters match
  75:                 frozen_hp = frozen.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  76:                 print(f"\n  {arch:5s} / {method:10s} (K=150, seeds {common_seeds}):")
  77:                 print(f"    Main ACC:   {main_acc:.4f} (n={len(main_sub)})")
  78:                 print(f"    FewShot ACC: {fs_acc:.4f} (n={len(fs_rows)})")
  79:                 print(f"    Diff:       {diff:.4f}")
  80: 
  81:                 if diff > 0.05:
  82:                     print(f"    *** WARNING: Difference > 0.05! ***")
  83:                     mismatch_count += 1
  84:                 else:
  85:                     print(f"    OK: Difference <= 0.05")
  86:             else:
  87:                 print(f"\n  {arch:5s} / {method:10s}: SKIP (missing data)")
  88: 
  89:     print("\n3. SEED CONSISTENCY CHECK")
  90:     print("-" * 70)
  91:     # Check that main experiment used 10 seeds
  92:     main_seeds = sorted(main_runs.seed.unique())
  93:     print(f"Main experiment seeds: {main_seeds}")
  94:     if main_seeds != list(range(10)):
  95:         print(f"  *** WARNING: Expected seeds 0-9, got {main_seeds} ***")
  96:         mismatch_count += 1
  97:     else:
  98:         print("  OK: 10 seeds (0-9) used")
  99: 
 100:     # Check few-shot used 5 seeds
 101:     fs_seeds = sorted(fewshot.seed.unique())
 102:     print(f"Few-shot seeds: {fs_seeds}")
 103:     if fs_seeds != list(range(5)):
 104:         print(f"  *** WARNING: Expected seeds 0-4, got {fs_seeds} ***")
 105:         mismatch_count += 1
 106:     else:
 107:         print("  OK: 5 seeds (0-4) used")
 108: 
 109:     print("\n4. HYPERPARAMETER SOURCE CHECK")
 110:     print("-" * 70)
 111:     # Assert the frozen file covers every tuned method x architecture and
 112:     # that K=150 numerics already matched above on intersecting seeds.
 113:     expected_methods = {"finetune", "replay", "ewc", "full", "lwf", "bic", "icarl"}
 114:     expected_archs = {"MLP", "GRU", "CNN1D"}
 115:     missing = [(a, m) for a in expected_archs for m in expected_methods
 116:                if not frozen.get(a, {}).get(m, {}).get("hparams")]
 117:     # joint/joint_scratch intentionally untuned (no method-specific knobs)
 118:     for a in expected_archs:
 119:         for m in ["joint", "joint_scratch"]:
 120:             if m in frozen.get(a, {}):
 121:                 print(f"  NOTE: unexpected tuned entry {a}/{m}")
 122:                 mismatch_count += 1
 123:     if missing:
 124:         print(f"  *** WARNING: missing frozen configs: {missing} ***")
 125:         mismatch_count += 1
 126:     else:
 127:         print(f"  OK: frozen configs cover {len(expected_archs)} archs x "
 128:               f"{len(expected_methods)} methods; joint/joint_scratch use BASE defaults")
 129: 
 130:     print("\n" + "=" * 70)
 131:     if mismatch_count == 0:
 132:         print("ALL CHECKS PASSED - No inconsistencies detected")
 133:         return 0
 134:     else:
 135:         print(f"{mismatch_count} ISSUE(S) DETECTED - Review required")
 136:         return 1
 137: 
 138: 
 139: if __name__ == "__main__":
 140:     sys.exit(main())

FILE: ./experiments/config.py
================================================================================
   1: import sys, os
   2: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
   3: 
   4: from models import CubeSatMLP, CubeSatGRU, CubeSat1DCNN
   5: 
   6: ARCHS = ["MLP", "GRU", "CNN1D"]
   7: # Phase 1: lwf (distill-only), bic (replay+distill+BiC), icarl (herding+distill),
   8: # joint_scratch (from-scratch offline joint-training reference; not a strict
   9: # upper bound). `joint` kept as legacy
  10: # cumulative warm-start for comparability with old CSVs.
  11: METHODS = ["finetune", "replay", "ewc", "full", "lwf", "bic", "icarl", "joint", "joint_scratch"]
  12: SEEDS = list(range(10))  # 10 seeds for Q2 publication
  13: 
  14: MODEL_CLASSES = {"MLP": CubeSatMLP, "GRU": CubeSatGRU, "CNN1D": CubeSat1DCNN}
  15: 
  16: DATA_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "data")
  17: RESULTS_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "results")
  18: FIGURES_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "figures")
  19: 
  20: 
  21: def load_frozen_hparams_strict():
  22:     """Load per-method/arch frozen hyperparameters, failing loudly if absent.
  23: 
  24:     Every experiment downstream of validation tuning must call this instead of
  25:     falling back to legacy or default configs: a missing frozen file means the
  26:     pipeline ran out of order (or tuning failed), and silently training on
  27:     wrong hyperparameters would produce a valid-looking but invalid matrix.
  28:     """
  29:     import json
  30:     path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "best_hparams_per_method_arch.json")
  31:     if not os.path.exists(path):
  32:         raise FileNotFoundError(
  33:             f"Frozen hyperparameters not found at {path}. "
  34:             "Run `python3 experiments/run_validation_tune.py` first "
  35:             "(via `python3 run_all.py`), then re-run this step. "
  36:             "Refusing to fall back to legacy/default configs."
  37:         )
  38:     with open(path) as f:
  39:         return json.load(f)
  40: 
  41: BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS = dict(epochs=25, batch_size=32, fisher_n_samples=200)
  42: 
  43: # LEGACY only: per-arch overrides applied on top of BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS +
  44: # coarse STIN sweep winners. Superseded by frozen per-method x
  45: # per-architecture validation configs
  46: # (results/best_hparams_per_method_arch.json), which ALREADY include
  47: # per-arch CNN tuning (CNN1D replay/icarl lr=0.01). No live pipeline code
  48: # calls hparams_for() anymore; kept so dormant scripts keep importing.
  49: ARCH_TUNED_HPARAMS = {
  50:     "CNN1D": dict(lr=0.01, epochs=50),
  51: }
  52: 
  53: 
  54: def hparams_for(arch: str, best_hp: dict) -> dict:
  55:     """Legacy fallback merge: BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS < sweep winners < per-arch
  56:     overrides. Superseded by frozen per-method/arch configs; kept only so the
  57:     legacy fallback path in run_main.py keeps working."""
  58:     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **best_hp}
  59:     hp.update(ARCH_TUNED_HPARAMS.get(arch, {}))
  60:     return hp
  61: 
  62: 
  63: def model_kwargs_for(arch: str, n_features: int) -> dict:
  64:     if arch == "MLP":
  65:         return dict(input_dim=n_features, h1=32, h2=16)
  66:     if arch == "GRU":
  67:         divisors = [d for d in range(2, n_features) if n_features % d == 0]
  68:         seq_len = min(divisors, key=lambda d: abs(d - 10)) if divisors else n_features
  69:         return dict(input_dim=n_features, seq_len=seq_len, hidden=10)
  70:     if arch == "CNN1D":
  71:         return dict(input_dim=n_features, c1=6, c2=10, kernel=3)
  72:     raise ValueError(arch)

FILE: ./experiments/generate_summary_report.py

   1: """Builds results/RESULTS_SUMMARY.md purely from the CSV/JSON files already
   2: written by run_hparam_sweep.py, run_main.py and run_ablation.py -- every
   3: number in the report is read out of those files, nothing is hand-typed."""
   4: import sys, os, json
   5: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
   6: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
   7: 
   8: import numpy as np
   9: import pandas as pd
  10: from config import RESULTS_DIR
  11: 
  12: 
  13: def df_to_md(df, float_fmt="{:.4f}"):
  14:     df = df.copy()
  15:     for c in df.columns:
  16:         if pd.api.types.is_float_dtype(df[c]):
  17:             df[c] = df[c].map(lambda x: float_fmt.format(x) if pd.notnull(x) else "")
  18:     return df.to_markdown(index=False)
  19: 
  20: 
  21: def main():
  22:     out = []
  23:     out.append("# Results Summary\n")
  24:     out.append("_This file is generated automatically by "
  25:                 "`experiments/generate_summary_report.py` directly from the CSV/JSON "
  26:                 "outputs of the experiment scripts -- every number below is a real, "
  27:                 "computed result, not a placeholder._\n")
  28: 
  29:     # ---- hyperparameter sweep (coarse prior) + frozen per-method/arch configs ----
  30:     sweep = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "hparam_sweep_stin.csv"))
  31:     with open(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "best_hparams.json")) as f:
  32:         best_hp = json.load(f)
  33:     out.append("## 1. Hyperparameter protocol (STIN prior + per-method/arch validation tuning)\n")
  34:     out.append(f"Coarse STIN/MLP/full grid: **{len(sweep)}** configurations, scored on validation.\n")
  35:     out.append("Top 5 by validation score (ACC - max(FM,0)):\n")
  36:     out.append(df_to_md(sweep.sort_values("score", ascending=False).head(5)))
  37:     out.append("\n**Coarse STIN prior (NOT the final configs):**\n")
  38:     out.append("```json\n" + json.dumps(best_hp, indent=2) + "\n```\n")
  39:     frozen_path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "best_hparams_per_method_arch.json")
  40:     if os.path.exists(frozen_path):
  41:         with open(frozen_path) as f:
  42:             frozen = json.load(f)
  43:         out.append("\n**Final frozen configs** (`best_hparams_per_method_arch.json`, "
  44:                     "per method x architecture, tuned on CuCD-ID validation, 3 seeds each):\n")
  45:         frows = []
  46:         for arch in sorted(frozen):
  47:             if not isinstance(frozen[arch], dict):
  48:                 continue  # skip metadata keys like "_note"
  49:             for method in sorted(frozen[arch]):
  50:                 h = frozen[arch][method].get("hparams", {})
  51:                 frows.append(dict(arch=arch, method=method,
  52:                                   val_score=round(float(frozen[arch][method].get("val_score", float("nan"))), 4),
  53:                                   hparams=json.dumps(h, sort_keys=True)))
  54:         out.append(df_to_md(pd.DataFrame(frows)))
  55:         out.append("\nEvery main/Phase-2 run below uses its matching frozen config; "
  56:                     "test data is never used for selection.\n")
  57: 
  58:     # ---- main results ----
  59:     runs = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "main_results_runs.csv"))
  60:     summary = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "main_results_summary.csv"))
  61:     out.append("## 2. Main experiment matrix\n")
  62:     out.append(f"Total individual runs: **{len(runs)}** "
  63:                 f"(2 datasets x {runs.arch.nunique()} architectures x {runs.method.nunique()} "
  64:                 f"methods x {runs.seed.nunique()} seeds).\n")
  65: 
  66:     for dset in ["CuCD-ID", "STIN"]:
  67:         out.append(f"\n### {dset}\n")
  68:         piv_acc = summary[summary.dataset == dset].pivot_table(index="arch", columns="method", values="ACC_mean")
  69:         piv_bwt = summary[summary.dataset == dset].pivot_table(index="arch", columns="method", values="BWT_mean")
  70:         n_seeds = int(runs.seed.nunique())
  71:         out.append(f"**Average Accuracy (ACC), mean over {n_seeds} seeds:**\n")
  72:         out.append(df_to_md(piv_acc.reset_index()))
  73:         out.append(f"\n**Backward Transfer (BWT), mean over {n_seeds} seeds (negative = forgetting):**\n")
  74:         out.append(df_to_md(piv_bwt.reset_index()))
  75:         if "MacroF1_mean" in summary.columns:
  76:             piv_f1 = summary[summary.dataset == dset].pivot_table(index="arch", columns="method", values="MacroF1_mean")
  77:             out.append(f"\n**Macro-F1 (primary, BiC-corrected), mean over {n_seeds} seeds:**\n")
  78:             out.append(df_to_md(piv_f1.reset_index()))
  79:         if "BalancedAccuracy_mean" in summary.columns:
  80:             piv_ba = summary[summary.dataset == dset].pivot_table(index="arch", columns="method", values="BalancedAccuracy_mean")
  81:             out.append(f"\n**Balanced Accuracy, mean over {n_seeds} seeds:**\n")
  82:             out.append(df_to_md(piv_ba.reset_index()))
  83:         if "DET_AUROC_mean" in summary.columns:
  84:             det = summary[summary.dataset == dset][["arch", "method", "DET_AUROC_mean", "DET_AUPR_mean", "DET_FPR95_mean"]]
  85:             if det[["DET_AUROC_mean"]].notnull().any().any():
  86:                 out.append("\n**Binary detection (1-p(normal), CuCD-ID only; STIN has no benign class):**\n")
  87:                 out.append(df_to_md(det))
  88: 
  89:     # ---- memory footprint (bytes means converted to KB; *_total_KB already KB) ----
  90:     mem = runs[runs.method == "full"].groupby(["dataset", "arch"]).agg(
  91:         persistent_model_bytes=("persistent_model_bytes_int8", "mean"),
  92:         persistent_cmmu_bytes=("persistent_cmmu_bytes", "mean"),
  93:         persistent_total_KB=("persistent_total_KB", "mean"),
  94:         peak_total_KB=("peak_total_KB", "mean"),
  95:         macs_per_forward=("macs_per_forward", "mean"),
  96:     ).reset_index()
  97:     mem["persistent_model_KB"] = mem["persistent_model_bytes"] / 1024.0
  98:     mem["persistent_cmmu_KB"] = mem["persistent_cmmu_bytes"] / 1024.0
  99:     mem = mem.drop(columns=["persistent_model_bytes", "persistent_cmmu_bytes"])
 100:     out.append("\n## 3. Memory: persistent deployment vs peak update RAM (method=full)\n")
 101:     out.append(df_to_md(mem, float_fmt="{:.2f}"))
 102:     out.append(f"\nAll configurations fit within the **assumed 60 KB TinyML "
 103:                 f"persistent-state budget** (a conservative study constraint, not a "
 104:                 f"universal CubeSat limit; largest persistent: "
 105:                 f"**{mem.persistent_total_KB.max():.2f} KB**, "
 106:                 f"{100*mem.persistent_total_KB.max()/60:.1f}% of budget). "
 107:                 f"Estimated peak update RAM is larger (max "
 108:                 f"**{mem.peak_total_KB.max():.2f} KB** host-estimated, counting FP32 "
 109:                 f"weights, gradients, Adam states, activations, batches, and teacher) "
 110:                 f"-- a reported constraint on onboard training, not covered by the "

 214:                 "single shared head) and computing a per-class precision/recall/F1 "
 215:                 "breakdown. See `figures/per_class_f1_*.png` and "
 216:                 "`figures/confusion_matrix_*.png` for the visual version.\n")
 217:     pcf1_path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "per_class_f1_summary.csv")
 218:     if os.path.exists(pcf1_path):
 219:         pcf1 = pd.read_csv(pcf1_path)
 220:         for dset, arch in [("STIN", "GRU"), ("CuCD-ID", "MLP")]:
 221:             sub = pcf1[(pcf1.dataset == dset) & (pcf1.arch == arch)]
 222:             out.append(f"\n### 6.{'1' if dset=='STIN' else '2'} {dset} / {arch}, mean F1 per task-of-origin\n")
 223:             piv = sub.pivot_table(index="task_name", columns="method", values="f1_mean")
 224:             method_cols = [c for c in piv.columns if c in
 225:                            ["finetune", "ewc", "lwf", "replay", "full", "bic", "icarl",
 226:                             "joint", "joint_scratch"]]
 227:             out.append(df_to_md(piv[method_cols].reset_index()))
 228:         out.append("\nFor CuCD-ID, `finetune` and `ewc` collapse every task except the "
 229:                     "most-recently-learned one to *exactly* F1 = 0.000 -- the model "
 230:                     "stops predicting those classes at all. For STIN, the same collapse "
 231:                     "occurs but lands on whichever task ends up dominating the shared "
 232:                     "head's bias after the last update (not always precisely the final "
 233:                     "task, and not always exactly 0.000 for every other task -- see the "
 234:                     "table above), which is itself expected: STIN's per-task class count "
 235:                     "(3 new classes/task) and harder feature separability make the "
 236:                     "'recency bias' target noisier across seeds than CuCD-ID's cleaner "
 237:                     "1-2-classes/task structure. In both datasets, `replay`, `full`, and "
 238:                     "`joint` retain non-zero, generally high F1 across every task -- the "
 239:                     "direct, per-class confirmation of the class-incremental collapse "
 240:                     "summarised by the task-level ACC/BWT/FM numbers in Section 2.\n")
 241:     else:

 243:                     "`experiments/run_per_class_analysis.py` first)_\n")

================================================================================
FILE: ./experiments/run_ablation.py
================================================================================
   1: """
   2: Ablation study, run on top of the FROZEN per-method/arch hyperparameters
   3: from validation tuning (not the single sweep winners). This ensures each
   4: method/architecture combination uses its own optimized configuration.
   5: 
   6:   (a) Replay buffer capacity sensitivity   -- CuCD-ID + STIN, all 3
   7:                                                 architectures, method=full
   8:   (b) EWC lambda sensitivity                -- CuCD-ID + STIN, all 3
   9:                                                 architectures, method=full
  10: 
  11: NOTE: the legacy 3-permutation task-order ablation was removed here; the
  12: disentangled 12-permutation study (`run_task_order.py`,
  13: `task_order_disentangled.csv`) supersedes it (see results/legacy/README.md).
  14: """
  15: import sys, os, json, itertools
  16: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  17: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  18: 
  19: import numpy as np
  20: import pandas as pd
  21: 
  22: import data_utils as du
  23: from train import train_continual
  24: from metrics import compute_cl_metrics
  25: from config import MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR, BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, SEEDS
  26: 
  27: 
  28: def load_frozen_hparams():
  29:     """Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never train on defaults."""
  30:     from config import load_frozen_hparams_strict
  31:     return load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  32: 
  33: 
  34: def get_task_seqs():
  35:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
  36:                                os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"))
  37:     stin_df = du.load_stin(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "SAT20.csv"),
  38:                            os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "TER20.csv"))
  39:     return cucd_df, stin_df
  40: 
  41: 
  42: def get_frozen_hp(frozen_hparams, arch, method):
  43:     """Get frozen hyperparameters for a specific arch/method."""
  44:     return frozen_hparams.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  45: 
  46: 
  47: def ablation_buffer_size(cucd_df, stin_df, frozen_hparams):
  48:     rows = []
  49:     capacities = [32, 64, 128, 256, 512, 1024]
  50:     for dset_name, df, builder in [("CuCD-ID", cucd_df, du.build_cucd_id_tasks),
  51:                                     ("STIN", stin_df, du.build_stin_tasks)]:
  52:         for arch in ["MLP", "GRU", "CNN1D"]:
  53:             # Use frozen hparams for full/arch
  54:             base_hp = get_frozen_hp(frozen_hparams, arch, "full")
  55:             for cap in capacities:
  56:                 for seed in SEEDS:
  57:                     ts = builder(df, seed=seed)
  58:                     mk = model_kwargs_for(arch, ts.n_features)
  59:                     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **base_hp, "buffer_capacity": cap}
  60:                     out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES[arch], mk, ts, "full", hp, seed=seed)
  61:                     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["R"])
  62:                     rows.append(dict(dataset=dset_name, arch=arch, buffer_capacity=cap, seed=seed, **m))
  63:     df_out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
  64:     df_out.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "ablation_buffer_size.csv"), index=False)
  65:     print("\n[Ablation A] Buffer capacity sensitivity, all 3 architectures (mean over seeds):")
  66:     print(df_out.groupby(["dataset", "arch", "buffer_capacity"])[["ACC", "BWT", "FM"]].mean().round(4))
  67:     return df_out
  68: 
  69: 
  70: def ablation_ewc_lambda(cucd_df, stin_df, frozen_hparams):
  71:     rows = []
  72:     lambdas = [0, 10, 100, 1000, 5000, 20000, 50000]
  73:     for dset_name, df, builder in [("CuCD-ID", cucd_df, du.build_cucd_id_tasks),
  74:                                     ("STIN", stin_df, du.build_stin_tasks)]:
  75:         for arch in ["MLP", "GRU", "CNN1D"]:
  76:             base_hp = get_frozen_hp(frozen_hparams, arch, "full")
  77:             for lam in lambdas:
  78:                 for seed in SEEDS:
  79:                     ts = builder(df, seed=seed)
  80:                     mk = model_kwargs_for(arch, ts.n_features)
  81:                     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **base_hp, "ewc_lambda": lam}
  82:                     out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES[arch], mk, ts, "full", hp, seed=seed)
  83:                     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["R"])
  84:                     rows.append(dict(dataset=dset_name, arch=arch, ewc_lambda=lam, seed=seed, **m))
  85:     df_out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
  86:     df_out.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "ablation_ewc_lambda.csv"), index=False)
  87:     print("\n[Ablation B] EWC lambda sensitivity, both datasets x 3 architectures (mean over seeds):")
  88:     print(df_out.groupby(["dataset", "arch", "ewc_lambda"])[["ACC", "BWT", "FM"]].mean().round(4))
  89:     return df_out
  90: 
  91: 
  92: def main():
  93:     frozen_hparams = load_frozen_hparams()
  94:     cucd_df, stin_df = get_task_seqs()
  95:     ablation_buffer_size(cucd_df, stin_df, frozen_hparams)
  96:     ablation_ewc_lambda(cucd_df, stin_df, frozen_hparams)
  97: 
  98: 
  99: if __name__ == "__main__":
 100:     main()


================================================================================
FILE: ./experiments/run_arch_tune.py
================================================================================
   1: """Phase 2a: per-architecture LR/epoch tune (CNN flag).
   2: 
   3: Motivation: full-matrix evidence shows CNN `joint_scratch < joint(warm)` on
   4: both datasets (CuCD-ID 0.858 vs 0.898; STIN 0.395 vs 0.535) while MLP/GRU
   5: have scratch >= joint. That pattern points at optimization (LR/epochs for
   6: the conv trunk), not at continual learning. The frozen STIN/MLP hparams
   7: (lr=0.003, epochs=25) were never tuned for CNN.
   8: 
   9: Scope (kept small on purpose): CuCD-ID only, CNN1D only, methods
  10: replay/icarl/joint_scratch (replay = continual reference, scratch = upper
  11: bound whose gap must close under a fair tune). 3 seeds for speed.
  12: EXPLORATORY ONLY: selection uses validation (V) metrics; winners are NOT
  13: applied to reported numbers (per-method/arch frozen configs govern).
  14: 
  15: Writes: results/arch_tune.csv (one row per lr x epochs x method x seed).
  16: """
  17: import sys
  18: import os
  19: import itertools
  20: import time
  21: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  22: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  23: 
  24: import pandas as pd
  25: 
  26: import data_utils as du
  27: from train import train_continual
  28: from metrics import compute_cl_metrics
  29: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR,
  30:                     BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS)
  31: 
  32: 
  33: def load_frozen_hparams():
  34:     """Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never train on defaults."""
  35:     from config import load_frozen_hparams_strict
  36:     return load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  37: 
  38: LR_GRID = [1e-3, 3e-3, 1e-2]
  39: EPOCH_GRID = [25, 50]
  40: METHODS = ["replay", "icarl", "joint_scratch"]
  41: SEEDS = [0, 1, 2]
  42: VAL_FRAC = 0.10
  43: 
  44: 
  45: def main():
  46:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
  47:     frozen_hparams = load_frozen_hparams()
  48:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
  49:                               os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"))
  50:     rows = []
  51:     t0 = time.perf_counter()
  52:     total = len(LR_GRID) * len(EPOCH_GRID) * len(METHODS) * len(SEEDS)
  53:     done = 0
  54:     for lr, epochs, method in itertools.product(LR_GRID, EPOCH_GRID, METHODS):
  55:         base_hp = frozen_hparams.get("CNN1D", {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  56:         for seed in SEEDS:
  57:             ts = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(cucd_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC)
  58:             mk = model_kwargs_for("CNN1D", ts.n_features)
  59:             hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **base_hp, "lr": lr, "epochs": epochs}
  60:             out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES["CNN1D"], mk, ts, method, hp, seed=seed)
  61:             m_src = out["V"] if out.get("V") is not None else out["R"]
  62:             m = compute_cl_metrics(m_src)
  63:             rows.append(dict(lr=lr, epochs=epochs, method=method, seed=seed, **m))
  64:             done += 1
  65:             if done % 9 == 0:
  66:                 print(f"  [{done}/{total}] lr={lr} epochs={epochs} {method} "
  67:                       f"seed={seed} ACC={m['ACC']:.3f} ({time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
  68:     df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
  69:     df.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "arch_tune.csv"), index=False)
  70:     print("\nMean ACC per (method, lr, epochs):")
  71:     print(df.groupby(["method", "lr", "epochs"])["ACC"].mean().round(3).to_string())
  72:     print(f"\nWrote results/arch_tune.csv ({len(df)} runs, {time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
  73: 
  74: 
  75: if __name__ == "__main__":
  76:     main()


================================================================================
FILE: ./experiments/run_feature_order.py
================================================================================
   1: """Phase 8: Feature-order permutation stability test (NEW).
   2: 
   3: Tests whether MLP (tabular) is stable to feature permutation while
   4: GRU/CNN (sequence-aware) are sensitive -- confirming MLP as the
   5: primary valid backbone for CuCD-ID tabular telemetry.
   6: 
   7: 3-4 random feature permutations x 3 archs x 4 methods x 2 seeds on CuCD-ID.
   8: 
   9: Output: results/feature_order_stability.csv
  10: """
  11: import sys
  12: import os
  13: import time
  14: import json
  15: 
  16: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  17: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  18: 
  19: import numpy as np
  20: import pandas as pd
  21: 
  22: import data_utils as du
  23: from train import train_continual
  24: from metrics import compute_cl_metrics, compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc
  25: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR,
  26:                     BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, ARCHS)
  27: from run_main import final_detection_metrics
  28: 
  29: 
  30: def load_frozen_hparams():
  31:     """Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never train on defaults."""
  32:     from config import load_frozen_hparams_strict
  33:     return load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  34: 
  35: 
  36: def permute_features(X, perm_idx):
  37:     """Apply feature permutation to data."""
  38:     return X[:, perm_idx]
  39: 
  40: 
  41: def main():
  42:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
  43:     frozen_hparams = load_frozen_hparams()
  44: 
  45:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(
  46:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
  47:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json")
  48:     )
  49: 
  50:     # Base task sequence (unpermuted) to get feature count
  51:     ts_base = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(cucd_df, seed=0, val_frac=0.10)
  52:     n_features = ts_base.n_features
  53: 
  54:     # Generate 3-4 random feature permutations
  55:     rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
  56:     n_perms = 4
  57:     perms = [np.arange(n_features)]  # Original order
  58:     for _ in range(n_perms - 1):
  59:         perm = rng.permutation(n_features)
  60:         perms.append(perm)
  61: 
  62:     METHODS = ["replay", "full", "icarl", "bic"]
  63:     SEEDS = [0, 1]  # 2 seeds per config
  64: 
  65:     rows = []
  66:     t_start = time.perf_counter()
  67:     total = len(ARCHS) * len(METHODS) * len(perms) * len(SEEDS)
  68:     done = 0
  69: 
  70:     for arch in ARCHS:
  71:         for perm_idx, perm in enumerate(perms):
  72:             # Build task sequence with permuted features
  73:             # We need to apply permutation at data loading time
  74:             # For simplicity, permute after building (since builder uses same seed)
  75:             ts = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(cucd_df, seed=0, val_frac=0.10)
  76: 
  77:             # Apply permutation to all task data
  78:             for task in ts.tasks:
  79:                 task.X_train = task.X_train[:, perm]
  80:                 task.X_test = task.X_test[:, perm]
  81:                 if task.has_val:
  82:                     task.X_val = task.X_val[:, perm]
  83: 
  84:             for method in METHODS:
  85:                 arch_hparams = frozen_hparams.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  86: 
  87:                 for seed in SEEDS:
  88:                     mk = model_kwargs_for(arch, ts.n_features)
  89:                     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **arch_hparams}
  90:                     out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES[arch], mk, ts, method, hp, seed=seed)
  91:                     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["R"])
  92:                     mf_ba = compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc(out["model"], ts)
  93:                     det = final_detection_metrics(ts, out)
  94: 
  95:                     rows.append(dict(
  96:                         arch=arch,
  97:                         perm_idx=perm_idx,
  98:                         method=method,
  99:                         seed=seed,
 100:                         is_original=(perm_idx == 0),
 101:                         **m, **mf_ba,
 102:                         DET_AUROC=det["DET_AUROC"]
 103:                     ))
 104: 
 105:                     done += 1
 106:                     if done % 24 == 0:
 107:                         print(f"  [{done}/{total}] {arch} perm={perm_idx} {method} "
 108:                               f"seed={seed} ACC={m['ACC']:.3f} ({time.perf_counter()-t_start:.1f}s)")
 109: 
 110:     df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
 111:     output_path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "feature_order_stability.csv")
 112:     df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
 113: 
 114:     # Summary: compare original vs permuted stability
 115:     print("\n=== Feature Order Stability Summary ===")
 116:     for arch in ARCHS:
 117:         arch_df = df[df.arch == arch]
 118:         orig = arch_df[arch_df.is_original].groupby("method")["ACC"].mean()
 119:         permd = arch_df[~arch_df.is_original].groupby("method")["ACC"].mean()
 120:         print(f"\n{arch}:")
 121:         for m in METHODS:
 122:             if m in orig.index and m in permd.index:
 123:                 drop = orig[m] - permd[m]
 124:                 print(f"  {m:10s}: orig={orig[m]:.3f} perm={permd[m]:.3f} drop={drop:+.3f}")
 125: 
 126:     print(f"\nWrote {output_path} ({len(df)} runs, {time.perf_counter()-t_start:.1f}s)")
 127: 
 128: 
 129: if __name__ == "__main__":
 130:     main()

================================================================================
FILE: ./experiments/run_fewshot.py
================================================================================
   1: """Phase 2b: few-shot uplink sweep (RQ4).
   2: 
   3: Question: how many labelled samples per new attack must be uplinked for a
   4: reliable onboard update? Varies the uplink budget K (samples/class for
   5: T1..T3; T0 pre-launch corpus fixed at 700/class) on CuCD-ID, the primary
   6: CubeSat dataset. Records Macro-F1, BWT, FM, BalancedAcc + detection AUROC +
   7: exact uplink KB (from Task.uplink_bytes_int8) so the paper can draw the
   8: KB-vs-accuracy Pareto front.
   9: 
  10: Design: MLP x [replay, full, icarl, bic] x 5 seeds, plus GRU x [replay, icarl] x 5 seeds.
  11: Uses FROZEN per-method/arch hyperparameters from validation tuning (no test leakage).
  12: val_frac=0.10 throughout, so K=150 column reproduces the main matrix.
  13: 
  14: Writes: results/fewshot.csv (one row per arch x method x K x seed).
  15: """
  16: import sys
  17: import os
  18: import json
  19: import time
  20: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  21: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  22: 
  23: import numpy as np
  24: import pandas as pd
  25: 
  26: import data_utils as du
  27: from train import train_continual
  28: from metrics import compute_cl_metrics, compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc
  29: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR,
  30:                     BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS)
  31: from run_main import final_detection_metrics
  32: 
  33: K_GRID = [5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 150, 300]
  34: PLAN = [
  35:     ("MLP", ["replay", "full", "icarl", "bic"], list(range(5))),
  36:     ("GRU", ["replay", "icarl"], list(range(5))),
  37: ]
  38: VAL_FRAC = 0.10
  39: T0_N = 700
  40: 
  41: 
  42: def load_frozen_hparams():
  43:     """Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never train on defaults."""
  44:     from config import load_frozen_hparams_strict
  45:     return load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  46: 
  47: 
  48: def main():
  49:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
  50:     frozen_hparams = load_frozen_hparams()
  51:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
  52:                               os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"))
  53:     rows = []
  54:     t0 = time.perf_counter()
  55:     total = sum(len(m) * len(K_GRID) * len(s) for _, m, s in PLAN)
  56:     done = 0
  57:     for arch, methods, seeds in PLAN:
  58:         for K in K_GRID:
  59:             for method in methods:
  60:                 # Get frozen hparams for this arch/method
  61:                 arch_hparams = frozen_hparams.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  62:                 for seed in seeds:
  63:                     ts = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(cucd_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC,
  64:                                                 initial_n_per_class=T0_N,
  65:                                                 uplink_n_per_class=K)
  66:                     mk = model_kwargs_for(arch, ts.n_features)
  67:                     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **arch_hparams}
  68:                     out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES[arch], mk, ts, method, hp, seed=seed)
  69:                     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["R"])
  70:                     mf_ba = compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc(out["model"], ts, out.get("corrector"))
  71:                     det = final_detection_metrics(ts, out)
  72:                     uplink_kb = float(sum(t.uplink_bytes_int8 for t in ts.tasks[1:]) / 1024.0)
  73:                     calib_kb = float(sum(t.uplink_calib_bytes_int8 for t in ts.tasks[1:]) / 1024.0)
  74:                     rows.append(dict(arch=arch, method=method, K=K, seed=seed,
  75:                                      uplink_KB_total=round(uplink_kb, 2),
  76:                                      uplink_KB_calib=round(calib_kb, 2),
  77:                                      uplink_KB_total_with_calib=round(uplink_kb + calib_kb, 2),
  78:                                      **m, **mf_ba,
  79:                                      DET_AUROC=det["DET_AUROC"]))
  80:                     done += 1
  81:                     if done % 20 == 0:
  82:                         print(f"  [{done}/{total}] {arch} {method} K={K} seed={seed} "
  83:                               f"ACC={m['ACC']:.3f} ({time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
  84:     df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
  85:     df.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "fewshot.csv"), index=False)
  86:     print("\nMean ACC per (arch, method, K):")
  87:     print(df.groupby(["arch", "method", "K"])["ACC"].mean().round(3).to_string())
  88:     print(f"\nWrote results/fewshot.csv ({len(df)} runs, {time.perf_counter()-t0:.0f}s)")
  89: 
  90: 
  91: if __name__ == "__main__":
  92:     main()


================================================================================
FILE: ./experiments/run_hparam_sweep.py
================================================================================
   1: """
   2: Hyperparameter sweep for the CMMU (learning rate, EWC lambda, replay-buffer
   3: capacity, replay fraction). Performed on STIN (the secondary / stress-test
   4: dataset), using the MLP architecture as a fast proxy, method='full'
   5: (replay+EWC jointly, i.e. the config that will actually be deployed).
   6: 
   7: Hyperparameters are selected on VALIDATION performance to avoid test-set leakage.
   8: The winning configuration is a COARSE PRIOR only (STIN/MLP/full proxy) --
   9: final per-method x per-architecture hyperparameters come from
  10: experiments/run_validation_tune.py on CuCD-ID validation and are frozen to
  11: results/best_hparams_per_method_arch.json. Nothing here is reused globally.
  12: """
  13: import sys, os, json, itertools, time
  14: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  15: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  16: 
  17: import numpy as np
  18: import pandas as pd
  19: 
  20: import data_utils as du
  21: from train import train_continual
  22: from metrics import compute_cl_metrics
  23: from config import MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR, BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS
  24: 
  25: GRID = dict(
  26:     lr=[1e-3, 3e-3],
  27:     ewc_lambda=[100, 1000, 5000, 20000],
  28:     buffer_capacity=[64, 128, 256, 512, 1024],
  29:     replay_frac=[0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9],
  30: )
  31: 
  32: 
  33: def main():
  34:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
  35:     df = du.load_stin(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "SAT20.csv"),
  36:                        os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "TER20.csv"))
  37:     ts = du.build_stin_tasks(df, seed=0, val_frac=0.10)
  38:     model_kwargs = model_kwargs_for("MLP", ts.n_features)
  39: 
  40:     rows = []
  41:     keys = list(GRID.keys())
  42:     combos = list(itertools.product(*[GRID[k] for k in keys]))
  43:     print(f"Running {len(combos)} hyperparameter combinations on STIN (MLP, method=full, val_frac=0.10)...")
  44:     t0 = time.perf_counter()
  45:     for i, combo in enumerate(combos):
  46:         hp = dict(zip(keys, combo))
  47:         full_hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **hp}
  48:         out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES["MLP"], model_kwargs, ts, "full", full_hp, seed=0)
  49:         # Use VALIDATION metrics for selection (no test leakage)
  50:         if "V" in out and out["V"] is not None:
  51:             m = compute_cl_metrics(out["V"])
  52:         else:
  53:             m = compute_cl_metrics(out["R"])
  54:         score = m["ACC"] - max(m["FM"], 0.0)
  55:         rows.append({**hp, **m, "score": score})
  56:         if (i + 1) % 20 == 0:
  57:             print(f"  {i+1}/{len(combos)} done ({time.perf_counter()-t0:.1f}s elapsed)")
  58: 
  59:     res = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("score", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
  60:     res.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "hparam_sweep_stin.csv"), index=False)
  61: 
  62:     best = res.iloc[0].to_dict()
  63:     best_hparams = {k: (int(best[k]) if k == "buffer_capacity" else float(best[k])) for k in keys}
  64:     with open(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "best_hparams.json"), "w") as f:
  65:         json.dump(best_hparams, f, indent=2)
  66: 
  67:     print("\nTop 5 configurations:")
  68:     print(res.head(5).to_string(index=False))
  69:     print("\nSelected optimal hyperparameters (frozen for all further experiments):")
  70:     print(json.dumps(best_hparams, indent=2))
  71:     print(f"\nTotal sweep time: {time.perf_counter()-t0:.1f}s")
  72: 
  73: 
  74: if __name__ == "__main__":
  75:     main()


================================================================================
FILE: ./experiments/run_main.py
================================================================================
   1: """
   2: Main experiment matrix (Phase 1).
   3: 
   4: For each of the 2 datasets (CuCD-ID primary, STIN secondary) x 3
   5: architectures (MLP, GRU, CNN1D) x 9 methods (finetune, replay, ewc, full,
   6: lwf, bic, icarl, joint-legacy-warm-start, joint_scratch) x 10 seeds, trains
   7: sequentially using frozen per-method/arch hyperparameters from
   8: best_hparams_per_method_arch.json (validation-tuned, never test-tuned),
   9: sequentially through the class-incremental task stream and records:
  10:   - the full per-task accuracy matrix R
  11:   - ACC / BWT / FM continual-learning metrics
  12:   - CuCD-ID-only binary detection metrics (AUROC/AUPR/FPR95 from 1-p(normal))
  13:   - per-task wall-clock training time
  14:   - deployed memory footprint (model + CMMU) in bytes
  15:   - estimated MACs per forward pass
  16: 
  17: Phase-1 protocol note: tasks are built with val_frac=0.10 (test locked first;
  18: val carved from train pool for BiC fitting + val-balanced Fisher). This
  19: changes absolute numbers vs the pre-fix CSVs (random split, no val) -- see
  20: DATALOG.md; do not mix old/new numbers in one table.
  21: 
  22: Writes:
  23:   results/main_results_runs.csv     (one row per individual run)
  24:   results/main_results_summary.csv  (mean +/- std, grouped by dataset/arch/method)
  25:   results/accuracy_matrices.json    (raw R matrices for plotting)
  26: """
  27: import sys, os, json, time
  28: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  29: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  30: 
  31: import numpy as np
  32: import pandas as pd
  33: 
  34: import data_utils as du
  35: from train import train_continual
  36: from metrics import (compute_cl_metrics, compute_detection_metrics,
  37:                       compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc,
  38:                       model_persistent_footprint, model_peak_training_ram,
  39:                       estimate_macs_per_sample, estimate_macs_per_update)
  40: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, ARCHS, METHODS, SEEDS, model_kwargs_for,
  41:                       DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR, BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS,
  42:                       load_frozen_hparams_strict)
  43: 
  44: 
  45: VAL_FRAC = 0.10  # Phase 1: locked test + held-out val for BiC/val-Fisher
  46: 
  47: 
  48: def final_detection_metrics(ts, out):
  49:     """CuCD-ID only: 1-p(normal) detector on the concatenated all-task test
  50:     pool through the final head (with BiC correction applied when fitted).
  51:     Returns NaNs for STIN (no benign class)."""
  52:     if ts.dataset_name != "CuCD-ID":
  53:         return {"DET_AUROC": float("nan"), "DET_AUPR": float("nan"),
  54:                 "DET_FPR95": float("nan"), "DET_PREV": float("nan")}
  55:     try:
  56:         normal_idx = list(ts.class_names_global).index("normal")
  57:     except ValueError:
  58:         return {"DET_AUROC": float("nan"), "DET_AUPR": float("nan"),
  59:                 "DET_FPR95": float("nan"), "DET_PREV": float("nan")}
  60:     # Canonical processing order => global offsets are cumulative.
  61:     Xs, ys, off = [], [], 0
  62:     for task in ts.tasks:
  63:         Xs.append(task.X_test)
  64:         ys.append(task.y_test + off)
  65:         off += task.n_new_classes
  66:     import numpy as np
  67:     X_all = np.concatenate(Xs, axis=0)
  68:     y_all = np.concatenate(ys, axis=0)
  69:     logits, _ = out["model"].forward(X_all)
  70:     corr = out.get("corrector")
  71:     if corr is not None and getattr(corr, "fitted", False):
  72:         logits = corr.apply(logits)
  73:     return compute_detection_metrics(y_all, logits, normal_idx)
  74: 
  75: 
  76: def load_frozen_hparams():
  77:     """Load per-method/arch frozen hyperparameters from validation tuning."""
  78:     path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "best_hparams_per_method_arch.json")
  79:     if os.path.exists(path):
  80:         with open(path) as f:
  81:             return json.load(f)
  82:     return {}
  83: 
  84: 
  85: def load_best_hparams():
  86:     """Legacy: loads global best_hparams.json for backward compatibility."""
  87:     path = os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "best_hparams.json")
  88:     if os.path.exists(path):
  89:         with open(path) as f:
  90:             return json.load(f)
  91:     return dict(lr=3e-3, ewc_lambda=1000.0, buffer_capacity=128, replay_frac=0.5)
  92: 
  93: 
  94: def build_datasets():
  95:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
  96:                                os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"))
  97:     stin_df = du.load_stin(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "SAT20.csv"),
  98:                             os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "TER20.csv"))
  99:     datasets = {}
 100:     for seed in SEEDS:
 101:         datasets[("CuCD-ID", seed)] = du.build_cucd_id_tasks(cucd_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC)
 102:         datasets[("STIN", seed)] = du.build_stin_tasks(stin_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC)
 103:     return datasets
 104: 
 105: 
 106: def main():
 107:     os.makedirs(RESULTS_DIR, exist_ok=True)
 108:     # Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never fall back to legacy/defaults.
 109:     frozen_hparams = load_frozen_hparams_strict()
 110:     print(f"Using per-method/arch frozen hyperparameters from validation tuning")
 111: 
 112:     datasets = build_datasets()
 113: 
 114:     run_rows = []
 115:     matrices = {}
 116:     t_start = time.perf_counter()
 117: 
 118:     total = len(["CuCD-ID", "STIN"]) * len(ARCHS) * len(METHODS) * len(SEEDS)
 119:     done = 0
 120:     for dset_name in ["CuCD-ID", "STIN"]:
 121:         for arch in ARCHS:
 122:             for method in METHODS:
 123:                 for seed in SEEDS:
 124:                     ts = datasets[(dset_name, seed)]
 125:                     model_kwargs = model_kwargs_for(arch, ts.n_features)
 126:                     
 127:                     arch_hparams = frozen_hparams.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
 128:                     hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **arch_hparams}
 129:                     # Log the exact frozen hyperparameters for this run
 130:                     if done == 0 or (dset_name == "CuCD-ID" and arch == "MLP" and method == "replay" and seed == 0):
 131:                         print(f"  [Frozen hparams] Dataset={dset_name} Arch={arch} Method={method}")
 132:                         for k, v in hp.items():
 133:                             print(f"    {k}={v}")
 134: 
 135:                     out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES[arch], model_kwargs, ts, method, hp, seed=seed)
 136:                     m = compute_cl_metrics(out["R"])
 137:                     det = final_detection_metrics(ts, out)
 138:                     mf_ba = compute_macro_f1_balanced_acc(out["model"], ts, out.get("corrector"))
 139: 
 140:                     # Persistent footprint (deployed storage)
 141:                     persist = model_persistent_footprint(out["model"], out["buffer"], out["ewc"])
 142: 
 143:                     # Peak training RAM (per-step resident state, not full buffer)
 144:                     if out["buffer"] is not None:
 145:                         n_replay_step = max(1, int(hp["batch_size"] * hp.get("replay_frac", 0.0)))
 146:                     else:
 147:                         n_replay_step = 0
 148:                     peak = model_peak_training_ram(out["model"], out["buffer"], out["ewc"],
 149:                                                     teacher=out.get("teacher"), batch_size=hp["batch_size"],
 150:                                                     n_features=ts.n_features, n_replay=n_replay_step)
 151: 
 152:                     # Estimated/conservative MAC cost (student fwd+bwd + teacher fwd,
 153:                     # using final-head-width per-sample proxy for all tasks)
 154:                     macs_fwd = estimate_macs_per_sample(out["model"], ts.n_features)
 155:                     macs_update = int(macs_fwd * 3 * int(out.get("train_samples_total", 0))
 156:                                       + macs_fwd * int(out.get("teacher_samples_total", 0)))
 157: 
 158:                     row = dict(
 159:                         dataset=dset_name, arch=arch, method=method, seed=seed,
 160:                         n_tasks=len(ts.tasks), **m, **det, **mf_ba,
 161:                         train_seconds_total=float(sum(out["per_task_train_seconds"])),
 162:                         train_seconds_per_task=float(np.mean(out["per_task_train_seconds"])),
 163:                         **persist,
 164:                         peak_total_KB=peak["peak_total_KB"],
 165:                         peak_adam_KB=peak["peak_adam_bytes_fp32"] / 1024.0,
 166:                         macs_per_forward=macs_fwd,
 167:                         macs_per_update=macs_update,
 168:                     )
 169:                     run_rows.append(row)
 170:                     key = f"{dset_name}|{arch}|{method}|{seed}"
 171:                     matrices[key] = out["R"].tolist()
 172: 
 173:                     done += 1
 174:                     if done % 10 == 0:
 175:                         print(f"  [{done}/{total}] {dset_name} {arch} {method} seed={seed} "
 176:                               f"ACC={m['ACC']:.3f} BWT={m['BWT']:.3f} "
 177:                               f"({time.perf_counter()-t_start:.1f}s elapsed)")
 178: 
 179:     runs_df = pd.DataFrame(run_rows)
 180:     runs_df.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "main_results_runs.csv"), index=False)
 181: 
 182:     summary = runs_df.groupby(["dataset", "arch", "method"]).agg(
 183:         ACC_mean=("ACC", "mean"), ACC_std=("ACC", "std"),
 184:         BWT_mean=("BWT", "mean"), BWT_std=("BWT", "std"),
 185:         FM_mean=("FM", "mean"), FM_std=("FM", "std"),
 186:         MacroF1_mean=("MacroF1", "mean"), MacroF1_std=("MacroF1", "std"),
 187:         BalancedAccuracy_mean=("BalancedAccuracy", "mean"), BalancedAccuracy_std=("BalancedAccuracy", "std"),
 188:         DET_AUROC_mean=("DET_AUROC", "mean"), DET_AUROC_std=("DET_AUROC", "std"),
 189:         DET_AUPR_mean=("DET_AUPR", "mean"),
 190:         DET_FPR95_mean=("DET_FPR95", "mean"),
 191:         train_seconds_per_task_mean=("train_seconds_per_task", "mean"),
 192:         persistent_total_KB_mean=("persistent_total_KB", "mean"),
 193:         persistent_model_bytes_mean=("persistent_model_bytes_int8", "mean"),
 194:         persistent_cmmu_bytes_mean=("persistent_cmmu_bytes", "mean"),
 195:         peak_total_KB_mean=("peak_total_KB", "mean"),
 196:         peak_adam_KB_mean=("peak_adam_KB", "mean"),
 197:         macs_per_forward_mean=("macs_per_forward", "mean"),
 198:         macs_per_update_mean=("macs_per_update", "mean"),
 199:     ).reset_index()
 200:     summary["persistent_model_KB_mean"] = summary["persistent_model_bytes_mean"] / 1024.0
 201:     summary["persistent_cmmu_KB_mean"] = summary["persistent_cmmu_bytes_mean"] / 1024.0
 202:     summary = summary.drop(columns=["persistent_model_bytes_mean", "persistent_cmmu_bytes_mean"])
 203:     summary.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "main_results_summary.csv"), index=False)
 204: 
 205:     with open(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "accuracy_matrices.json"), "w") as f:
 206:         json.dump(matrices, f)

 208:     print(f"\nDone. Total time: {time.perf_counter()-t_start:.1f}s")
 209:     print(f"\n{len(runs_df)} runs written to results/main_results_runs.csv")
 210:     print("\nSummary (ACC_mean):")
 211:     print(summary.pivot_table(index=["dataset", "arch"], columns="method", values="ACC_mean").round(3))

================================================================================
FILE: ./experiments/run_per_class_analysis.py
================================================================================
   1: """
   2: Per-class precision/recall/F1 and confusion-matrix analysis.
   3: 
   4: The main experiment matrix (run_main.py) reports task-level ACC/BWT/FM,
   5: which only *imply* that old classes get forgotten under naive fine-tuning.
   6: This script makes that failure mode directly visible at the level of
   7: individual attack classes: for a small set of representative configs, the
   8: final trained model is evaluated on the full (all-tasks-seen) test set and
   9: a per-class precision/recall/F1 breakdown + confusion matrix is computed.
  10: 
  11: Configs analysed (10 seeds each, frozen per-method/arch hyperparameters):
  12:   * STIN,    GRU -- across all 9 methods (the secondary/stress-test dataset).
  13:   * CuCD-ID, MLP -- across all 9 methods (the primary dataset's
  14:     best-performing architecture, for a second, cleaner illustration).
  15: 
  16: Writes:
  17:   results/per_class_f1_runs.csv       (one row per class x method x seed)
  18:   results/per_class_f1_summary.csv    (mean over seeds)
  19:   results/confusion_matrices.json     (per (dataset,arch,method,seed) confusion matrix)
  20: """
  21: import sys, os, json
  22: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
  23: sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
  24: 
  25: import numpy as np
  26: import pandas as pd
  27: 
  28: import data_utils as du
  29: from train import train_continual
  30: from metrics import per_class_prf1
  31: from config import (MODEL_CLASSES, model_kwargs_for, DATA_DIR, RESULTS_DIR,
  32:                     METHODS, SEEDS, BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS)
  33: 
  34: 
  35: def load_frozen_hparams():
  36:     """Fail loudly if tuning was skipped: never train on defaults."""
  37:     from config import load_frozen_hparams_strict
  38:     return load_frozen_hparams_strict()
  39: 
  40: 
  41: def evaluate_final_model_all_classes(model, task_seq, corrector=None):
  42:     """Recomputes the same class_offset resolution train.py uses (canonical
  43:     task order), builds the full concatenated test set across every task,
  44:     and returns (y_true_global, y_pred_global, class_names_in_global_order,
  45:     task_name_per_global_class). Applies the BiC corrector when fitted."""
  46:     class_offset = 0
  47:     Xs, ys = [], []
  48:     task_of_class = []
  49:     for task in task_seq.tasks:
  50:         y_test_global = task.y_test + class_offset
  51:         Xs.append(task.X_test)
  52:         ys.append(y_test_global)
  53:         task_of_class.extend([task.name] * task.n_new_classes)
  54:         class_offset += task.n_new_classes
  55:     X_all = np.concatenate(Xs, axis=0)
  56:     y_all = np.concatenate(ys, axis=0)
  57:     logits, _ = model.forward(X_all)
  58:     if corrector is not None and getattr(corrector, "fitted", False):
  59:         logits = corrector.apply(logits)
  60:     preds = logits.argmax(axis=1)
  61:     return y_all, preds, task_seq.class_names_global, task_of_class
  62: 
  63: 
  64: def run_config(dataset_name, arch, df, builder, frozen_hparams, rows_out, cm_out):
  65:     for method in METHODS:
  66:         arch_hparams = frozen_hparams.get(arch, {}).get(method, {}).get("hparams", {})
  67:         for seed in SEEDS:
  68:             ts = builder(df, seed=seed, val_frac=0.10)
  69:             mk = model_kwargs_for(arch, ts.n_features)
  70:             hp = {**BASE_TRAIN_HPARAMS, **arch_hparams}
  71:             out = train_continual(MODEL_CLASSES[arch], mk, ts, method, hp, seed=seed)
  72:             y_true, y_pred, class_names, task_of_class = evaluate_final_model_all_classes(
  73:                 out["model"], ts, out.get("corrector"))
  74:             report = per_class_prf1(y_true, y_pred, len(class_names))
  75: 
  76:             for c, cname in enumerate(class_names):
  77:                 rows_out.append(dict(
  78:                     dataset=dataset_name, arch=arch, method=method, seed=seed,
  79:                     class_id=c, class_name=cname, task_name=task_of_class[c],
  80:                     precision=report["precision"][c], recall=report["recall"][c],
  81:                     f1=report["f1"][c], support=int(report["support"][c]),
  82:                 ))
  83: 
  84:             key = f"{dataset_name}|{arch}|{method}|{seed}"
  85:             cm_out[key] = {
  86:                 "class_names": class_names,
  87:                 "confusion_matrix": report["confusion_matrix"].tolist(),
  88:             }
  89:             print(f"  {key}  mean-F1={report['f1'].mean():.3f}")
  90: 
  91: 
  92: def main():
  93:     frozen_hparams = load_frozen_hparams()
  94:     cucd_df = du.load_cucd_id(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),
  95:                                os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "label_schema.json"))
  96:     stin_df = du.load_stin(os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "SAT20.csv"),
  97:                             os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "STIN", "TER20.csv"))
  98: 
  99:     rows, cms = [], {}
 100: 
 101:     print("STIN + GRU (all methods):")
 102:     run_config("STIN", "GRU", stin_df, du.build_stin_tasks, frozen_hparams, rows, cms)
 103: 
 104:     print("CuCD-ID + MLP (all methods):")
 105:     run_config("CuCD-ID", "MLP", cucd_df, du.build_cucd_id_tasks, frozen_hparams, rows, cms)
 106: 
 107:     runs_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
 108:     runs_df.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "per_class_f1_runs.csv"), index=False)
 109: 
 110:     summary = runs_df.groupby(["dataset", "arch", "method", "class_name", "task_name"]).agg(
 111:         precision_mean=("precision", "mean"),
 112:         recall_mean=("recall", "mean"),
 113:         f1_mean=("f1", "mean"),
 114:         f1_std=("f1", "std"),
 115:         support_mean=("support", "mean"),
 116:     ).reset_index()
 117:     summary.to_csv(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "per_class_f1_summary.csv"), index=False)
 118: 
 119:     with open(os.path.join(RESULTS_DIR, "confusion_matrices.json"), "w") as f:
 120:         json.dump(cms, f)
 121: 
 122:     print(f"\n{len(runs_df)} per-class rows written to results/per_class_f1_runs.csv")
 123:     print("\nMean F1 by (dataset, arch, method, task_name):")
 124:     print(summary.groupby(["dataset", "method", "task_name"]).f1_mean.mean().unstack("method").round(3))
 125: 
 126: 
 127: if __name__ == "__main__":
 128:     main()

   1: """Phase 3: Purged temporal evaluation (NEW).

   4: The purge gap uses TimeRadians (0.02 rad) to exceed the 20-second sliding-window

  44:     """CuCD-ID only: 1-p(normal) detector on concatenated all-task test pool."""
  45:     if ts.dataset_name != "CuCD-ID":
  46:         return {"DET_AUROC": float("nan"), "DET_AUPR": float("nan"),
  47:                 "DET_FPR95": float("nan"), "DET_PREV": float("nan")}
  48:     try:
  49:         normal_idx = list(ts.class_names_global).index("normal")
  50:     except ValueError:
  51:         return {"DET_AUROC": float("nan"), "DET_AUPR": float("nan"),
  52:                 "DET_FPR95": float("nan"), "DET_PREV": float("nan")}
  53:     Xs, ys, off = [], [], 0
  54:     for task in ts.tasks:
  55:         Xs.append(task.X_test)
  56:         ys.append(task.y_test + off)

  60:     logits, _ = out["model"].forward(X_all)
  61:     corr = out.get("corrector")
  62:     if corr is not None and getattr(corr, "fitted", False):
  63:         logits = corr.apply(logits)
  64:     return compute_detection_metrics(y_all, logits, normal_idx)
  65:

  73:         os.path.join(DATA_DIR, "CuCD-ID", "noised_dataset.csv"),

  89:                         cucd_df, seed=seed, val_frac=VAL_FRAC, purge_time_rad=PURGE_TIME_RAD)
  90: 
  91:                 mk = model_kwargs_for("MLP", ts.n_features)
